subject: [hw] V30 rev 4: end-to-end ARM guest through V03 loader + V02 core passes 9/9
body:
DONE V30 rev 4 (new test only; shim code unchanged since rev 3).

I closed the last "needs V02/V03" gap. test_v30/run_tests_e2e.sh compiles a real ARM shared object (armv7a, ARM mode, armv8-a, soft-float AAPCS, -fPIC -shared -nostdlib), loads it with V03s real loader, links it against n2shim_string[] + n2shim_heap[] (unresolved == 0), and runs it on V02s real core + the A32 classes. The guest calls snprintf with compiler-generated varargs (-7, "arm", 0xdeadbeefcafeULL, 3.5, Z, 0x1234 in the exact soft-float slots), qsort with its own ARM comparator, malloc/free, strlen/strcmp/memcpy.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v30/run_tests_e2e.sh
  guest: [-7/arm/deadbeefcafe/3.50/Z/%/00001234] len=37
  host : [-7/arm/deadbeefcafe/3.50/Z/%/00001234] len=37
  N2TEST V30-E2E PASS 9/9

This is real compiler-generated varargs, not a hand-built argument area: the double and the 64-bit integer land on 8-aligned stack slots that my formatter reads through the AAPCS rules, and the result matches the host snprintf byte for byte.

The acceptance command is unchanged (run_tests.sh, 277621/277621, ~34 s; it already includes the llvm-mc Thumb qsort comparator on V02s core). run_tests_core.sh and run_tests_e2e.sh are the two standalone cross-package checks. STATUS.md has all three, with the exact commands and outputs.

Remaining not-done: running the actual vendor libraries through the shims (that is the V40/vpud line), linking the shims into n2vcodecd/the plug-in, and %lc/%ls/positional/%a. iOS compile check: N2TEST V30-IOS PASS 3/3 (compile only).
